title: Commercial service market sizing
prompt:
Prepare the Year 3 expansion-territory market sizing for commercial mechanical service.

Use the Q2 board, lender, and investor-relations correspondence and the source-tie follow-up, together with the July 3 controller-reviewed market support, current market-data pull, comparability decisions, and approved market methodology. Treat the June 27 banker pull as comparison history only, and resolve any differences from dates, approval status, and the source-tie follow-up.

Build the sizing separately for Healthcare, Data centers, Education, and Light industrial. For each segment, use the approved addressable site count, annual mechanical service spend per site, outsourced-service penetration, geographic and capability serviceability, and Year 3 obtainable share. Keep total addressable market, serviceable available market, and the Year 3 obtainable dollar market distinct. Set Year 3 revenue equal to the obtainable dollar market under this capture case, calculate the technician requirement from the documented revenue capacity per technician, and identify the largest documented sensitivity by absolute revenue swing.

Do not modify files or post transactions. Return only one JSON object with exactly these keys: `total_addressable_market`, `serviceable_available_market`, `three_year_obtainable_market`, `year_three_revenue`, `required_year_three_technicians`, `largest_market_sizing_sensitivity`. Use dollar values to two decimals, counts as whole numbers, and lists as JSON arrays.
